subject: [PATCH 6/6] test/daxctl-devices.sh: cycle offline/online to cover unplug and replug

reviews.author: Gregory (Meta) (author)
reviews.summary:
Author acknowledged that the patch does not test backward compatibility as expected, but agreed to proceed with the current implementation.

Author acknowledged the need to repeat online/offline pair to cover onlining from 'unplugged' and agreed that it's a good idea, no specific fix planned.
reviews.raw_body:
this is slightly confusing, but noted.  I would have expected the tests
to test backward compatibility.  But ack.

---

ack.

Thanks Alison!

-- 
~Gregory

2026-10-22.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the daxctl-devices.sh script that cycles an online device offline and back online, simulating unplug and replug scenarios. The test checks block counts and kernel memory states after each step, ensuring correct behavior in various modes (system-ram and devdax). Additionally, it verifies that unplugging a device works even if it's already offline. This patch aims to improve the robustness of daxctl by covering edge cases related to device online/offline transitions.

reviews.author: Alison Schofield
reviews.summary: Reviewer suggested adding a check for minimum kernel version to ensure the test only runs on supported kernels and fails if necessary attributes are missing.
reviews.raw_body:
SKIP if kernel version doesn't support. You'll see this pattern in other
unit tests:

check_min_kver "7.3" || do_skip "kernel may lack ...."

After that, fail if kernel version should support yet the attribute is missing.

-- Alison
